findings.title: Downsizing can permanently discard GIF animation
findings.body: This resizes the upload in place and enables animated processing only when `allow_animated_thumbnails` is true. When that setting is false, `OptimizedImage.downsize` uses the non-animated ImageMagick instructions, which read only `from[0]`; an oversized animated GIF is therefore replaced by a single-frame image before it is stored. The thumbnail setting should not silently destroy animation in the uploaded original.
